name: Rob Wagner

positions.statement: On his campaign priorities page, Wagner says across-the-board tariffs are making everything more expensive.
positions.excerpt: unconstitutional and irresponsible across-the-board tariffs are making everything more expensive

positions.statement: On his campaign priorities page, Wagner says supporting immigrant and refugee neighbors is as important now as ever.
positions.excerpt: Supporting our immigrant and refugee neighbors is as important now as ever.

positions.statement: On his campaign priorities page, Wagner says the U.S. Constitution guarantees due process and freedom of speech.

positions.statement: On his campaign priorities page, Wagner says protecting reproductive freedom and gender-affirming care in Oregon will continue to be a priority.

positions.statement: On his campaign priorities page, Wagner says addressing Oregon's housing shortage is of critical importance.
positions.excerpt: The numbers make it clear that addressing our housing shortage is of such critical importance.

positions.statement: On his campaign priorities page, Wagner says he believes gun safety is public safety and public health.
positions.excerpt: I believe that gun safety is public safety and public health.

positions.statement: On his campaign priorities page, Wagner says he has worked to keep firearms out of schools and create strong standards for safe storage of firearms.
positions.excerpt: I’ve worked to keep firearms out of schools, create strong standards for safe storage of firearms,

positions.statement: In a March 2023 Senate President press release on the housing and homelessness package, Wagner said the Legislature worked across the aisle to put Oregon on a path to available, affordable housing.
positions.excerpt: Faced with a statewide housing and homelessness crisis, we worked across the aisle and with our partners in the House and Governor's office to put Oregon on a path toward a future where housing is available and affordable for everyone.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Office of the Senate President (oregonlegislature.gov/wagner)

positions.statement: In a March 2022 statement as Senate Majority Leader, Wagner said he was excited about investments in the behavioral health workforce and directing $333 million toward evidence-based opioid use disorder programs.
positions.excerpt: I’m excited about our recent $132 million investment in behavioral health workforce and our action to direct $333 million in incoming funds towards evidence-based programs to treat opioid use disorder and other behavioral health issues.
